correctness.rationale: For fixed T>0 and h=T/N, Bernoulli coefficient perturbation a_h=-1+xi_j (xi_j=±1) induces primitive W_h(t)=∫xi. The pathwise strictly convex L² optimal control is Phi(W_h)=(I+K_W* K_W)^-1 K_W*1, a twice continuously differentiable map of continuous primitive W with uniform Taylor remainder O(||W||∞²). Differentiating the Volterra kernel gives DK_0[W]=∫(phi_r⊗psi_r)W’(r)dr, yielding first variation ∫ G_r xi(r)dr. Hilbert-valued Lindeberg/Rademacher CLT and E||W_h||∞^4=O(h²) give h^-1/2(u_h-u)=>∫G dB with covariance ∫G⊗G; control MSE/h→∫||G||² and deterministic quadratic regret/h→1/2∫<G,HG>. Strict x(r)>0 from positive Dirichlet–Robin Green function and negative tail of HG_r prove G nonzero for all r in (0,T), so constants >0. Independent discretized operator directional derivative at n=40,80 had norm errors ≲1.2e-10. Scope is offline pathwise minimizer, not online control or general matrices.
